rules.text: Documentation-only proposed first macOS developer preview release plan. Current full gate remains unchanged without explicit owner approval. Review for contradictions, unapproved gate changes, misleading source/performance or release claims, missing core safety/distribution blockers, unbounded loops, unrealistic unconditional promises, and failure to deliver a consumable SDK as well as the application. This is a proposal, not an already executed release. Existing 33.3ms cutoff failed; no performance experiment is requested. Relevant prior source evidence is linked. Focus actionable material issues.
